capabilities: Derive contact history from links in dated notes
Assign cadence tiers and flag people whose contact rhythm is drifting
Queue overdue people for reach-outs and log contacts
Track open follow-up tasks per person
Import contact details from a Google Contacts CSV or vCard export
disambiguation: Not a business CRM; it manages personal relationships by reading mentions in your own dated notes rather than storing contact records.
extras: Release assets are built in CI with build provenance; no hotkeys are bound by default, including undo; documentation covers performance figures, known limits, and the Google import is a file import, not a live connection.
problem: People already record interactions with others in daily and meeting notes, but nothing in Obsidian reads those mentions as a contact log, so keeping in touch relies on memory or manual tracking.

relations.evidence: Import contact details from a Google Contacts export
Due dates are read if the task carries one, in the Tasks plugin's
Templater's tp.date.now, tp.file.title and tp.file.cursor are translated to their result
it reads your Daily Notes or Periodic Notes configuration for the dated folder

summary: Personal CRM that derives contact history from [[wikilinks]] in dated notes, tracks a cadence per person, and queues who to reach out to.
